evidence:
frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/settings/notifications/components/DisableAllWarningDialog.tsx (131 lines, Epic 8A Story 8A.1) — the ENTIRE user-facing confirmation dialog is hardcoded English with NO useTranslation import (grep -c 'useTranslation|react-i18next' = 0). Untranslated visible copy: title `

Disable All Notifications?

` (:89-91); body `

You are about to disable all notification channels. This means you will not receive any notifications about:

` (:93-96); four bulleted items `
  • Important announcements from your property manager
    • `, `
  • Updates on reported faults and maintenance
    • `, `
  • Voting deadlines and results
    • `, `
  • Direct messages from neighbors
    • ` (:98-101); amber warning `

    You may miss critical information about your property.

    ` (:103-105); and BOTH action buttons `Disable All Notifications` (:117) and `Keep Notifications` (:124). This is a modal shown when a tenant tries to disable all notification channels, on a documented sk/cs/de/en multi-locale product (CLAUDE.md i18n: sk, cs, de, en) — a non-English user is shown an entirely English warning before a consequential opt-out. Distinct from the already-tracked generic aria-label-i18n finding (that covered aria-label *attributes*; this is visible body/button copy) and net-new vs all prior signals + backlog (grep for 'DisableAllWarningDialog' across .research/signals + backlog.json = 0 hits). Severity low per the i18n-gap taxonomy (no crash) but high confidence (literals are plainly visible, no dynamic path). Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): add useTranslation, replace each literal with a t('settings.notifications.disableAll.*') key, and add the keys to frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/i18n (+ sk/cs/de bundles). Low i18n-test risk; DisableAllWarningDialog.test.tsx (if present) asserting on the English strings would need updating to key lookups.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/settings/notifications/advanced/components/CategoryPreferenceCard.tsx — no useTranslation import; renders hardcoded English for notification-channel labels. A module-level `const CHANNEL_LABELS: Record<NotificationChannel, string> = { push: 'Push', email: 'Email', ... }` (:67-69+) supplies VISIBLE button text rendered at :130 `{CHANNEL_LABELS[channel]}`, not merely accessibility metadata. Also hardcoded: the per-channel tooltip `title={`${enabled ? 'Disable' : 'Enable'} ${CHANNEL_LABELS[channel]} for ${CATEGORY_LABELS[preference.category]}`}` (:125) — the 'Disable'/'Enable' verbs and sentence structure are English literals that will not localize, and the aria-label at :112 has the same 'notifications for' English glue. On the sk/cs/de/en product the per-category notification matrix shows English channel names and English tooltips to all locales. Net-new: grep for 'CategoryPreferenceCard' across .research/signals + backlog.json = 0 hits. PARTIAL overlap to flag for the triager: (a) the aria-label at :112 is the same class as the tracked aria-label-i18n finding; (b) CATEGORY_LABELS/CATEGORY_DESCRIPTIONS are imported from '@ppt/api-client' (:8), the same user-facing-labels-in-the-generated-client anti-pattern as the tracked contact-labels-in-api-client finding — so if that one is being fixed generically, the CATEGORY_LABELS half may be absorbed there. The genuinely NET-NEW, non-overlapping part is the locally-defined CHANNEL_LABELS map (visible button text at :130) and the 'Disable'/'Enable' tooltip verbs (:125), neither covered by any existing id. Severity low (i18n gap, no crash); confidence medium (visible literals confirmed, but fix scope entangled with the two related tracked findings above). Fix (frontend-only, cloud-landable): move CHANNEL_LABELS to t('settings.notifications.channels.*'), build the title/aria strings via t(... , { channel, category }) with interpolation, and add keys to the i18n bundles.
